rows.en:
(Well, classes are over. Maybe I'll chat
with someone before heading home...
Oh, it's Nanase.)
Hey, Nanase.

Oh, \p-kun.
What's up?

I just thought going straight home
would be kinda lonely...
Aren't you going home yet, Nanase?

Nope. I don't have my part-time job today,
so I thought I'd stop by the art room
and work on my assignment a bit...
rows.notes: x2, Nanase. hai answers the negative question, so 'Nope'.

rows.en: Wow, you're really dedicated, Nanase.

Huh? No, not at all.
I only do it because I love it...

By the way, the assignment's for the Art Course,
right? What are you working on?

Ranka-sa... of course...
Um... I mean, a painting with a person as the motif.
rows.notes: x2, Nanase blurts Ranka's name and cuts herself off. Word order changed (mochiron Ranka-sa...) so the cut name sits where she stops.

rows.en: Hm? Ranka, you said...

Ummm...
Yes, we work together at Nyan-Nyan.
She's sooo cute!

We go to different schools, but
we go out shopping and stuff together a lot!

Her voice is really cute too, and she always
calls me "Nana-chaaan!" and stuff.

It's not just about work anymore, I want...
Ah!? I'm sorry,
I've been doing all the talking...
rows.notes: x2, Nanase; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Nah, if you've got that much to say about her,
you two must be really close.
Yes, we are!

Oh, I have to go open up the art room soon...
See you.
Okay, good luck with your assignment.
(Nanase's quite the chatterbox, huh.)
Hey, Nanase.

Oh, \p-san.
What's up?
Hmm~, you're really dedicated, Nanase.

By the way, the assignment's for the Art Course,
isn't it? What are you working on?
Huh, Ranka-chan...?
Uh-huh, uh-huh.
Uh-huh... right...

No, no, if you've got that much to say about her,
you two must be really close, huh.
Okay, good luck with your assignment!
(Nanase's quite the chatterbox, isn't she.)
(Maybe I'll chat with Nanase again...)
Oh, \p-kun.
Working on your assignment in the art room again?
You sure work hard, huh.
Like I said, that's not true.
Ahaha. Well then, good luck with your assignment.
(Nanase must really love what she does.)
(Think I'll go chat with Nanase again~)
Oh, \p-san.
Another assignment in the art room?
You sure work hard, don't you.
(Nanase really does love what she does.)

(Maybe I'll stop by the art room
and see how Nanase's doing.)

Oh, \p-kun.
What brings you here?

Yeah, I thought I'd come watch for a bit,
if that's okay...

I was just about to take a break myself.
Would you like some tea with me?
Thanks. You sure came prepared.

Oh no, I always have some tea or something
when I take a breather.
Wow, that sounds kinda elegant.

Though it's just the same Chinese tea
we serve at Nyan-Nyan.
But it's really delicious.

So if you're making it, Nanase, that means
I get to drink the same tea they serve at the shop.
That makes me kinda happy.
Huh? Oh, it's really nothing special.
Hey, it's the truth.

Geez, flattering me won't get you anything
but tea, you know.

Here you go.
It's hot, so please be careful.
Wow, it smells really nice.

Yes!
You can enjoy tea in lots of ways:
by "looking," "smelling" and "drinking."
You're right, it's a really pretty color.

And if you take a deep breath before a sip,
it's amazing how calm it makes you feel.

Let's see...
Mmm, you're right. Funny how that works.

Yes. At work, Ranka-san sometimes makes
tea for me on our breaks.

Tea made by Ranka-san is really something else.
It's sooo much better than what I usually drink!

It's not just about work anymore, I want...
Ah!... I'm sorry, I'm doing all the talking again...
rows.notes: x2, Nanase; trails off as in the Japanese (same opening as c11495).

rows.en: No, no, you two really are close, huh.

Well, I'd just be in the way if I stayed forever,
so I'll head home now.

I see.
Come by anytime you feel like having tea again.
Okay, thanks for the tea.

(Phew, maybe it's thanks to the tea,
but my head feels kinda clear.)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders. sukkiri here is the ordinary word, not the 'refresh' gag, so not rendered 'refreshed'.

rows.en:
(Think I'll stop by the art room
and see how Nanase's doing~)

Oh, \p-san.
What brings you here?
Thanks. You sure came prepared.
Wow, that sounds kinda elegant, huh.

So if you're making it, Nanase, that means
I get to drink the same tea they serve at the shop.
That's kind of a treat.
Wow, it smells so nice.
You're right, it's such a pretty color.

Wow...
Mmm, you're right. It's strangely calming.
Okay, thank you for the tea.
rows.notes: Female (gochisousama desu, a touch more polite).

rows.en:
(Maybe I'll stop by the art room again
and see how Nanase's doing.)

Oh, \p-kun.
You came again.

Yeah. You're working on your assignment
again today, right, Nanase?

uncertain: c11490 (x2): Nanase starts to say 'Ranka-sa(n)' and cuts herself off; English moves 'of course' first so the cut name is where she stops. Also 'mochiron' could mean 'of course (I paint) Ranka', rendered that way.
